control.name: CONTROL — make the per-platform pin fallback unreachable (the defect, restated as a mutation)

mutations.name: let the per-platform line WIN over a bare line that is present (an existing consumer's verdict changes under it)
ask for the artifact PREFIX instead of the exact per-platform name (collapses the two pin lines into one match)
build the per-platform name even with no platform token (asks for `desk-tools-`, matching any line that starts that way)
drop the prs sweep's fail-closed propagation (one repo's hard error becomes a partial board that reads clean)
mutations.old: return prsPartial{}, err // exit 6, repo named — never a partial board
mutations.new: return prsPartial{}, nil // exit 6, repo named — never a partial board

mutations.name: turn the prs out-of-installation carve-out into a hard failure (a watched-but-uninstalled repo kills the board)
drop the stalled sweep's per-repo fail-closed propagation (#236: a clean board for a repo whose PRs were never read)
make the policy-drift probe fail-closed (an unreadable repo's metadata kills the desk's primary read)
mutations.old:
// could-not-read (incl. empty/absent visibility) is unobserved, not a guessed pass
			return visibilityObservation{repo: repo}, nil
mutations.new:
// could-not-read (incl. empty/absent visibility) is unobserved, not a guessed pass
			return visibilityObservation{repo: repo}, err

mutations.name: drop the per-root pool's fail-closed propagation (a root that could not be read silently vanishes from the queue)
let a failed shared root resolution blind only ONE of the two stages it fed
make the channel-D source line unreachable again (a source-pinned consumer reads as unpinned, and Next-up is could-not-check for it)
let the source line WIN over a release line that is present (an existing consumer's pin verdict changes under it)
skip a MALFORMED release line in favour of the source line (a broken pin is silently replaced instead of failing closed)
body-edit class (board): assume an edit after the CR instead of the edit time the sweep read (an unedited body lifts SUSPECT-APPROVAL — reddens TestBodyEdit_BoardUneditedBodyStaysSuspect)
body-edit class (board): wire a synthetic edit time into the sweep instead of the PR's lastEditedAt (reddens TestBodyEdit_BoardActionsEndToEnd/documented,_but_the_forge_records_no_edit_after_the_CR)
